tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Forest green, deep canopy leaves. Primary buttons, links, active states, key headings. Text on surface passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for primary fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a primary fill.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Sunlit leaf green. Illustrations, chips, map markers, large display accents. Under 4.5:1 on surface: use for text 24px+ or icons only.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Soft new-growth tint. Selected rows, tag backgrounds, highlight panels. Pair with ink text.

tokens.name: bark
tokens.usage: Tree-bark brown. Secondary buttons, section headers, footer, anything that grounds a layout. Passes 4.5:1 as text on surface.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Trail and soil brown. Decorative accents, badges, illustration fills. Under 4.5:1 on light surface: large text and icons only.

tokens.name: robin
tokens.usage: Robin's-egg blue. A quiet cool tint for info panels, tags, selected states and illustration. Background only; put ink on it.

tokens.name: robin-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper egg blue. Info text and icons, links inside robin panels. ≥4.5:1 on surface and robin.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Olive-gold, like a speckled brown egg. Decorative accents, rules, illustration. Large text or icons only on light surface.

tokens.name: speckle
tokens.usage: Speckle brown-gray. Dot textures and small decorative marks; also fine as secondary icon color.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: pale sage-khaki paper, like an old naturalist's plate / dark soil.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs: eggshell cream.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, sidebars, grouped sections.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on surface, surface-raised and moss.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders on surface (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (≥3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Ochre, autumn leaves. Warnings and pending states, text or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rust red. Errors and destructive actions only, text or icon.

families.display: "Source Serif 4", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif
families.sans: "Source Serif 4", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, form field gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards and groups.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panels, sheets, image frames, a soft canopy edge.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, toggles, avatar frames.
